"""Main-owned full fake-engine server regression; source and runtime scope stay separate."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl,hashlib,importlib.util,json,re,time,traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-latest-updates-20261012');BASE=W.parent/'diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012'
L=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py';assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('server_cpu_owner',O);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV=dict(PATH=str(L/'venv/bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',USER='yayoi',LOGNAME='yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1')
def ident(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-update-recheck-server-cpu-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 r=dict(active=True,complete=False,passed=False,commands=[],source=ident(Path(__file__)),environment=ENV,gpu_executed=False,model_executed=False,performance_measured=False)
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,wall=120):
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,ENV,W,wall=wall,cpu=wall*12+60,rss_cap=16<<30,text_cap=64<<20,total_cap=96<<20,file_cap=64<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save();assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label
  return so.read_text(),se.read_text()
 try:
  lp=B/'main-upstream-v0143-server-lints-root-v4/record.json';lint=json.loads(lp.read_text());assert lint['passed'] and lint['complete'] and not lint['active'];r['lint_receipt']=ident(lp)
  assert run('head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD'])[0].strip()=='78817e6dd69bab0177b1661835cd9c802a5acb7c'
  paths=run('source-list',['/usr/bin/git','ls-files'])[0].splitlines()
  r['source_pins']={name:m.sha(W/name) for name in paths if name.startswith('serve/') and (W/name).is_file()}
  r['source_pins'].update(lint['source_pins']);assert all(m.sha(W/p)==h for p,h in lint['source_pins'].items())
  engine=[name for name in paths if name.startswith(('src/','include/','cmake/','third_party/','data/')) or name in ['CMakeLists.txt','requirements.txt','setup.py']]
  assert all((W/name).is_file() and (BASE/name).is_file() and m.sha(W/name)==m.sha(BASE/name) for name in engine)
  r['unchanged_engine_files']=len(engine);r['unchanged_engine_base']='78817e6dd69bab0177b1661835cd9c802a5acb7c';save()
  run('handover-regression',[str(L/'venv/bin/python3'),'-B','-m','unittest','-v','serve.test_server.StatusHandover'])
  so,se=run('full-server-regression',[str(L/'venv/bin/python3'),'-B','-m','unittest','discover','-s','serve','-p','test_*.py','-v'],wall=900)
  hit=re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s',se);assert hit and re.search(r'^OK(?:\s|$)',se,re.M)
  skips=re.search(r'^OK \(skipped=(\d+)\)',se,re.M)
  assert int(hit[1]) == 555
  r['unittests']=dict(tests=int(hit[1]),elapsed_seconds=float(hit[2]),skipped=int(skips[1]) if skips else 0,individual_results=[v for v in se.splitlines() if v.startswith('test_')])
  assert all(m.sha(W/p)==h for p,h in r['source_pins'].items());r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as e:r['error']=repr(e);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error']}));raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
